verdicts.reason: A: the furniture photo has shrunk to an unreadable sliver jammed into the bottom-left corner. The red diagonal band is a stray floating chip, all the contact info (address, URL, phone) is gone, and most of the canvas is dead white, so it is unusable. B is also missing all the contact info, its red band is a meaningless floating fragment, and the headline breaks into four cramped lines. Still, the photo survives as a small half-circle under the headline, so it keeps a little more of the original's look and is the less bad of the two.
